raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 arrived with lowercase status ('posted'/'reversed') and '$'-prefixed amounts. The case-sensitive filter status = 'POSTED' dropped every row in the batch. Normalizing status case and stripping the '$' from amount restores them. The 363 lowercase 'posted' plus 15 lowercase 'reversed' rows equal batch 14's 378 rows, so the format change is confined to that batch.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
